body.cap: Kizling exhibition booth at CES 2026 Unveiled. Kizling received an Innovation Award in the Mobile Devices, Accessories & Apps category at this year’s CES. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: Kizling Inc., an AI-based children’s digital short-form challenge platform (CEO Hyelim Lee), participated in CES 2026 Unveiled, held on January 4 (local time) in Las Vegas, the United States.

CES Unveiled is a preview event held ahead of the main exhibition, starting January 6, designed to introduce selected innovative companies and their products to leading global media outlets. As a showcase for curated innovators to receive early, concentrated media attention, the event provided Kizling with an opportunity to showcase the competitiveness of its children-only interactive content platform on the international stage.

Ahead of CES 2026, Kizling was selected as a recipient of the CES Innovation Awards. Organized by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), the CES Innovation Awards recognize products and services that demonstrate outstanding technology, design, and innovation before the exhibition opens.

body.cap: Hyelim Lee, CEO of Kizling, gives an interview to AVING News reporter Jay Kennedy Markus. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: Kizling explained that the award recognized the innovativeness of its participatory edtech platform, which enables children to create content and participate in global challenges in a safe digital environment.

Beyond the CES Innovation Award, Kizling has continued to demonstrate its potential in the global market. The company recently gained recognition through its selection to HolonIQ’s “East Asia EdTech 150” and its third-place finish in the Korean finals of the Global EdTech Startup Awards (GESA), further validating the maturity and completeness of its service. Building on these achievements, Kizling is accelerating efforts to establish partnerships for entry into the U.S. and other global markets.

Through its participation in CES 2026 Unveiled, Kizling actively explored collaboration opportunities with global educational institutions, edtech companies, and content partners, particularly in North America. At the same time, the company introduced a SaaS-based solution for running online challenges and competitions for schools and institutions, signaling plans to expand into B2B and B2G markets.

Technologically, Kizling combines AI-based recommendation algorithms with content-safety filtering to deliver content optimized for children’s ages and interests. Its AI-driven challenge environment supports children in growing from passive content consumers into active creators, and has drawn attention as a next-generation solution that integrates digital literacy education with safe social networking.

Hyelim Lee, CEO of Kizling, said, “It is an honor to receive an innovation award at CES 2026, the world’s largest technology stage, and to participate in the Unveiled event where global media are focused,” adding, “We joined this event to share Kizling’s unique and innovative experience that enables children around the world to freely pursue their dreams in digital spaces.”

Meanwhile, the company will also participate in the leading CES 2026 exhibition, held from January 6 to 9, as part of the Seoul Pavilion located in Eureka Park, the startup-dedicated exhibition zone. The CES 2026 Seoul Pavilion, led by the Seoul Business Agency (SBA), brings together 19 startup support organizations in Seoul, including district offices, related institutions, and universities, to support 70 startups. The participating companies span advanced technology fields such as AI, mobility, and healthcare, and selected outstanding firms receive opportunities to participate in the official CES media event, CES Unveiled.

‘CES Unveiled’ is a key official event held before the CES opening, bringing together Innovation Award winners and companies showcasing cutting-edge products. The event brings together global media, company executives, government officials, and significant technology industry stakeholders in one place.
